messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — our Dedicated canary is showing a p95 spike for reserved-inference-prod after merge of PR #3421. ~2.1x p95 for text-gen with mixed seq lengths (notable at 32k short/long mixes). Can we hold the rollout?
ci-bot: [perf-alert] perf-suite/dedicated-p95 increased +120% on merge 3421. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/3421/perf
Kevin: Saw the alert. Kicking off a quick bisect on the canary image (staging). tagging @Julia @Anna to triage kernel/batching.
Julia: Pulled a flamegraph from the offending canary host. Top hotspots: kernel_selector::score(), batch_router::split_on_quant_hint(), and an unexpected branch in kernel_hint_eval(). Rough stack sample:
```
kernel_selector::score() +0x34
batch_router::prepare_batch() +0x58
batch_router::split_on_quant_hint() +0x12c
request_handler::serve() +0x78
```
Extra ~15-25ms per request concentrated during merge-window traffic pattern.
Anna: FYI PR 3421 changed the batching heuristic defaults (max_batch_wait_ms 4 -> 8) and adjusted the quantization hint path ordering. That could magnify latency when the hint misclassifies short sequences.
Kevin: Starting narrow revert of the batching heuristic lines from 3421 to confirm causality.
oncall-sre: Two paying Dedicated customers show increased tail latency (cust-A, cust-B). SLA exposure flagged. Recommend immediate canary hold and prepare revert. :warning:
Lisa: Rollout hold created: rollout/3421-hold. Notifying stakeholders and creating INF ticket. Perf-bisect ticket INF-7890 opened: https://infra/issues/INF-7890
Morgan: Agreed — hold rollout. If bisect points to the heuristic changes, revert merge and prepare hotfix: reintroduce previous kernel-hint fallback behavior + revert max_batch_wait change.
Julia: Quick profiler note — the quant-hint path does extra checks for short sequences causing branch misprediction. Proposed quick patch: early-exit for seq_len < 32 when quant_hint==false to avoid entering the expensive hint path. I'll open a PR for the hotfix now.
Kevin: CI bench run queued for the revert branch: perf-bench/3421-revert-run (ETA ~12m). Monitoring.
ci-bot: Perf-bench completed for branch revert-3421: p95 returned to baseline within noise. Results: https://ci.internal/bench/3421-revert/results
Morgan: Good signal. Next steps: rollback the canary to the revert build, then staged rollout across Dedicated clusters. Assigning @Kevin to coordinate revert rollout and @oncall-sre to handle customer comms.
Kevin: Will do staged revert: canary -> 3 dedicated clusters -> full. Updating the rollback runbook and will post live updates in this thread.
oncall-sre: Drafting customer message: "We're rolling back a recent inference runtime change that introduced increased tail latency for some workloads. We expect no data impact and will update once rollback completes." Will send after rollback. :email:
Morgan: Thanks. Follow-ups: add a unit test for kernel selection behavior on short sequences and a perf integration test to CI that simulates mixed short/long seq workload to catch similar regressions.
Anna: I'll open the test PRs after the hotfix lands.
Kevin: Rolling revert into canary now.
Morgan: Nice work. Keep updates coming. :thumbsup:
